# SerpCraft

> Free SEO meta tag studio: generate meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD structured data, robots.txt, and pixel-accurate SERP previews. Includes a URL debugger that shows exactly what search engines and social platforms read from any page — status, redirects, headers, meta tags, and conflicting signals.

## Tools

- SEO Check (free 21-point website audit + AI-readiness score): https://metaforge.app/seo-check
- SEO Studio (all-in-one editor + previews): https://metaforge.app/studio
- URL Debugger (see what crawlers actually read): https://metaforge.app/url-debugger
- llms.txt Generator (AI crawler file builder): https://metaforge.app/llms-txt-generator
- Hreflang Generator (multilingual tags with validation): https://metaforge.app/hreflang-generator
- OG Image Checker (server-side image verification): https://metaforge.app/og-image-checker
- JSON-LD Validator (structured data verification): https://metaforge.app/json-ld-validator
- Meta Tag Generator: https://metaforge.app/meta-tag-generator
- Open Graph Generator: https://metaforge.app/open-graph-generator
- Twitter Card Generator: https://metaforge.app/twitter-card-generator
- JSON-LD Generator: https://metaforge.app/json-ld-generator
- Schema Markup Generator: https://metaforge.app/schema-markup-generator
- Social Preview Tool: https://metaforge.app/social-preview-tool
- SERP Preview Tool: https://metaforge.app/serp-preview-tool
- Robots.txt Generator: https://metaforge.app/robots-txt-generator

## About

SerpCraft is a free, browser-based SEO meta tag studio. All user data stays in the browser via localStorage. No signup required.
